verdict: DO NOT SHIP. The mechanism the plan assumed - reconstruct hiding behind the tensor-pipe hgemm - does not exist at these shapes because reconstruct is STORE-BANDWIDTH-bound (~1.05 TB/s of a ~1.5 TB/s ceiling) and hgemm needs the remainder for its own operands: overlap re-divides the same bandwidth and adds event overhead. The GDN/norm gaps between MLPs do not rescue it at engine level (measured negative-to-flat). F5.2/F8's 'hides most of the 13% reconstruct share' premise is REFUTED for this card; the finding downgrades to structural: reconstruct time is bandwidth, and bandwidth is already committed.
transferable_lesson: in a bandwidth-contended regime, only removing bytes pays; re-scheduling them does not.
